recentItems.title: Ram Gopal Varma PRAISES Dhurandhar amid Toxic backlash, Poor Box Office! Is He Taking A Dig At Yash?
recentItems.description:
Ram Gopal Varma has once again heaped praise on Aditya Dhar’s ‘Dhurandhar’, and this time, the filmmaker has explained what he believes every director can learn from the Ranveer Singh-starrer. His comments have come amid the mixed response to Yash’s ‘Toxic’, adding a fresh layer to the ongoing discussion around star power and filmmaking. RGV has been a huge admirer of ‘Dhurandhar’ since the release of its first instalment. He has repeatedly praised the spy thriller, and in his latest post, he focused on how the film presents its characters and builds its world without relying solely on a superstar’s image.

#ramgopalvarma #yash #ranveersingh #toxic #dhurandhar #bollywood
